overview: 针对长动作序列（Long-chunk）策略在在线适应中样本效率低的问题，本文提出了ExRL方法。该方法不再直接优化动作序列，而是通过一个轻量级适配器学习动态调整每个动作块的执行时长，从而在降低优化维度的同时保持表达能力，实现了在真实场景中更高效的策略适应。

highlights.text: 提出了一种通过控制动作块执行长度进行在线适应的方法ExRL，有效降低了策略适应的搜索空间维度。
highlights.evidence: Our key insight is to shift adaptation from optimizing actions to optimizing how long to execute each predicted action chunk. This keeps the adaptation space low-dimensional while its expressivity grows with the chunk size.

highlights.text: ExRL在多种模拟及现实世界机器人任务中展现了高样本效率，且仅需极少的超参数调整。
highlights.evidence: Across simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic tasks, ExRL enables sample-efficient adaptation of a diverse range of long-chunk policies with minimal task-specific hyperparameter tuning.
